definition: A supplemental schedule for reporting interest income, ordinary dividend income, and disclosures regarding foreign financial accounts and foreign trusts.

includes.text: Contains a section for reporting all taxable interest income from various sources
Contains a section for reporting ordinary dividend income
Contains questions and disclosures about foreign financial accounts and foreign trust distributions

excludes.text: Reports only interest income without dividend reporting capability
Reports only dividend and distribution income without interest reporting
Reports mortgage interest paid by a borrower to a lender, not interest received by the taxpayer

discriminators.text: This schedule reports interest received by the taxpayer along with ordinary dividends and foreign account disclosures; the sibling reports only interest income received from financial institutions
This schedule reports both this document plus foreign account disclosures; the sibling reports only dividends and distributions from corporations and mutual funds
This schedule reports interest received by the taxpayer; the sibling reports mortgage interest paid by a borrower to a lending institution
